Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting certain extended warranties from sales and use taxation.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to extended warranties for tangible personalproperty exempt from sales and use taxation; adding a new section tochapter 82.08 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 82.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The sale of an extended warranty that warrants tangible personalproperty exempt from the sales tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 is alsoexempt from the tax levied by RCW 82.08.020.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The provisions of this chapter do not apply in respect to the useof an extended warranty that warrants tangible personal property exemptfrom use tax imposed under this chapter.
